canonical.behaviour: Fix three wrong refusals in the approval hook and add one line to builder briefs, as agreement 2 says. Delegated results, task notifications, question answers, context handoffs and T3 restart notices no longer count as the owner narrowing or withdrawing an approval; a User message inside a handoff or restart notice still counts. Builders quote the test runner's verbatim summary line and give file:line for claims about existing behaviour. Everything is built and tested in an ignored copy first.
